answer: Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted attestation with random audit: influence is proportional to locked collateral, not to the number of identities, so splitting capital across a thousand fake agents buys no extra vote. Audits sample attestations at random, and a false one slashes the stake behind it. That turns a mere whisper of fraud into a real forfeiture, while linking many small sparrow identities into a single vine of control only concentrates the same collateral into one penalty target. The attacker pays linearly for every increment of influence and risks losing it all.
